limits: Tests compiled existing normal local preview, without source edits, rebuild, installs, dependency override or publication.
Controlled fault injection delays a genuine native IndexedDB readwrite transaction before its put. This amplifies a pending-save window; it does not measure its typical production duration.
Course editor private optimistic state is intentional and is not treated as saved progress evidence.
All records are disposable synthetic signed-out fixtures. External requests are blocked and attempts are retained.
